# CareerScope

> A private, single-user job-lead finder. It parses one person's resume, scores
> job postings against it across seven weighted dimensions, and surfaces the
> matches. Every page behind the application shell renders that person's own
> data.

This deployment is **not** a public resource and hosts no reference material.
It is listed here only to state its terms plainly, because a missing llms.txt is
ambiguous about intent and this is not.

## Terms

- **Do not crawl.** [/robots.txt](/robots.txt) disallows all user agents, and
  every page carries `<meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow">` so the
  instruction survives being hosted under a subpath. Everything of substance
  sits behind owner authentication: an unauthenticated fetch of any URL here
  returns the application shell and nothing else.
- **Do not train on this deployment's contents.** What it serves is one
  individual's resume, salary expectations, contact details and job
  applications. That is personal data, not published work.

## Optional

- [/](/) — the application shell. Requires owner sign-in to show private data.
